fact: The Public Accounts ministry awarded Involys SA a sole-source (entente directe) technical assistance and platform upgrade contract for Vectis worth 977,359,662 (FCFA), approved 1 February 2024.
title: Assitance Technique VECTIS (Accompagnement fonctionnel et Mise à niveau de la Plateforme Technologique/Modernisation du système)
